exposure: VTE risk assessment using Chinese Expert Consensus
cohort: The study participants were Chinese women admitted to a hospital who received VTE risk assessment and preventive measures between May 2021 and August 2024.
finding: Current postpartum VTE prevention strategies in China are inadequate, with a significant number of VTE cases occurring despite prophylaxis, a delay in initiating LMWH, and limited predictive efficacy of the Chinese Consensus.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be significantly associated with VTE (P < 0.05).
gest_age: Measured; shorter gestational ages were observed in the VTE group (P < 0.05).
